research_question: Does applying SIC2 industry demeaning after annual signals are mapped to each stock-month recover the three V022 industry-adjusted failures?
formula_rule: Construct raw bm, chpm, and pchcapx from annual statements, attach the latest available annual statement to each stock-month using the frozen research master, derive SIC2 from the stock's SIC code at that month, and subtract the same-month same-SIC2 cross-sectional arithmetic mean.
diagnostic_basis: In GKX, bm minus bm_ia is numerically constant within month-SIC2 cells; the median within-cell standard deviation in 2010-2019 is 2.88e-10.
orientation_rule: Published positive directions are fixed before confirmation; no sign search or alternative industry estimators are allowed.
stopping_rule: Judge the single frozen monthly-industry formula for each feature once on 1990-1999. Report 2000-2019 only as post-lock stability evidence because it was exposed during predecessor experiments.
